          "id": "R-PREVIEW",
          "title": "Member discount in storefront preview",
          "statement": "storefront.preview(lines, member=False) returns subtotal_cents, discount_cents and total_cents; for member=True the discount is 10% of the subtotal floored to integer cents and capped at 2000 cents per order, otherwise no discount.",
          "status": "confirmed",
          "acceptance_criteria": [
            "Callers omitting member (or passing member=False) receive exactly the current undiscounted result: discount_cents 0 and total_cents equal to subtotal_cents.",
            "For member=True, discount_cents equals floor(10% of subtotal_cents) in integer cents, capped at 2000 cents per order.",
            "The result keeps exactly the three keys subtotal_cents, discount_cents and total_cents, with total_cents = subtotal_cents - discount_cents.",
            "An empty preview returns all three values as zero.",
            "Existing invalid-line validation remains: unknown SKU or non-int, bool, zero or negative quantity raises ValueError.",
            "Multiple entries for the same SKU are all counted in subtotal_cents normally.",
            "Membership input is a boolean parameter."
          ],
          "assumptions": []
        },
        {
          "id": "R-CHECKOUT",
          "title": "Member pricing and idempotent receipts in checkout",
          "statement": "Checkout.place_order(request_id, lines, member=False) charges exactly the preview policy total for the same lines and member flag, and a repeated successful request ID returns the original receipt without further effects.",
          "status": "confirmed",
          "acceptance_criteria": [
            "Callers omitting member are charged the undiscounted subtotal exactly as today.",
            "Member orders are charged exactly preview(lines, member=True)[\"total_cents\"].",
            "Receipt type and export_receipt output format remain unchanged; paid_cents is the charged final amount.",
            "Repeating a successful request ID returns the same original receipt object, even if the later lines or member flag differ or are invalid.",
            "A repeated successful request ID never charges or reserves inventory again and never replaces the first receipt.",
            "Membership input is a boolean parameter."
          ],
          "assumptions": []
        },
        {
          "id": "R-ATOMIC",
          "title": "Atomic failed checkout attempts",
          "statement": "When place_order fails in validation, stock or payment, stock, ledger charges and the receipt cache remain exactly as before the attempt.",
          "status": "confirmed",
          "acceptance_criteria": [
            "A validation failure leaves stock, ledger charges and receipt cache unchanged.",
            "An insufficient-stock failure leaves stock, ledger charges and receipt cache unchanged.",
            "A declined payment leaves stock, ledger charges and receipt cache unchanged; it may consume the simulator decline_next flag.",
            "After a declined attempt, a later retry with the same request ID can succeed once.",
            "Stock validation accounts for repeated SKU entries by their combined quantity.",
            "An empty order still raises ValueError."
          ],
          "assumptions": []
        },
        {
          "id": "R-PRESERVE",
          "title": "Preserved legacy totals and contracts",
          "statement": "Legacy gross totals, created receipt amounts, prices, receipt IDs, the payment ledger contract and default callers remain unchanged by the member discount.",

            "calculate_total(lines) keeps returning the undiscounted gross total.",
            "legacy_export.export_subtotal(lines) keeps returning the undiscounted gross_cents and never applies the member discount.",
            "Amounts of already created receipts are never rewritten.",
            "Default callers and existing tests continue to work unchanged.",
            "Prices, receipt IDs and the payment ledger contract do not change.",
            "Implementation uses the Python standard library only, integer cents only, and no external I/O or persistence."
          ],
          "assumptions": []
        }
      ],

# STORE-001 delivery report — Member discount with preserved checkout contracts

Delivered requirement baseline: **v2** (CHG-001 applied from v1; decision D-001 approved).
Tested code commit: `1468777162e46b4de4907c11732143154e809917` (clean tree for code; only `.agent-workflow/**` records uncommitted at report time).
Report written: 2026-09-30, after the test runs below. Test times are the recorded run times, not the writing time.

## Sources and requirement versions

| Source | Role | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `sources/prd-original.md` (= `prd-v1.md`, sha256 85b384e3…) | Approved v1 PRD | Unchanged; 10% / 2000 values superseded only for the member-discount percent/cap |
| `prd-v2.md` → `sources/revisions/21f36dc2…md` (byte-identical) | Approved revision v2 (product owner approval stated in the file and confirmed by the user in this session) | Registered as SRC-03 |
| `revisions/CHG-001.json` (sha256 179eca8c…) | Applied revision proposal, base v1 → v2 | Registered as SRC-02 |

API and Figma: not_applicable (PRD line 12: no GUI/API/Figma).

CHG-001 changed only R-PREVIEW `statement` and `acceptance_criteria[1]`: member discount = 15% of subtotal, floored to integer cents, capped at 1200 cents per order (was 10% / 2000). R-CHECKOUT charges the shared preview policy, so it picks up v2 without a wording change. The v1 intake aspects (S-5) are marked `superseded_by: CHG-001` with the original text kept. The new/ratified items are S-18..S-21. A full PRD review was recorded after the reconciliation.

## Requirement and task outcomes

| Requirement | Tasks | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| R-PREVIEW | T-1 (reworked for v2) | Implemented: `pricing.MEMBER_DISCOUNT_PERCENT=15`, `MEMBER_DISCOUNT_CAP_CENTS=1200`; `storefront.preview(lines, member=False)` |
